src=open('/dev/stdin').read() if False else None
code='''def norm(cells):
    ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
    y0,x0=min(ys),min(xs)
    return sorted((y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in cells)

def transform(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    fw=next(x for x in range(W) if all(grid[y][x]==0 for y in range(H)))
    left=[row[:fw] for row in grid]; right=[row[fw+1:] for row in grid]
    cells={}
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(len(right[0])):
            if right[y][x]: cells.setdefault(right[y][x],[]).append((y,x))
    shp={c:norm(v) for c,v in cells.items()}
    out=[row[:] for row in left]
    fc=left[0][0]
    used=set()
    frame_rows=[y for y in range(H) if all(left[y][x]==fc for x in range(fw))]
    frame_cols=[x for x in range(fw) if all(left[y][x]==fc for y in range(H))]
    rs=[y for y in range(H) if y not in frame_rows]
    bands=[]; cur=[rs[0]]
    for y in rs[1:]:
        if y==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(y)
        else: bands.append(cur); cur=[y]
    bands.append(cur)
    cs=[x for x in range(fw) if x not in frame_cols]
    for band in bands:
        zc=[(y,x) for y in band for x in cs if out[y][x]==0]
        zn=norm(zc)
        for c,s in shp.items():
            if c in used: continue
            if s==zn:
                used.add(c)
                ys=[y for y,x in zc]; xs=[x for y,x in zc]
                ty,tx=min(ys),min(xs)
                for (sy,sx) in s: out[ty+sy][tx+sx]=c
                for (y,x) in zc:
                    if out[y][x]==0: out[y][x]=fc
                break
        else:
            for (y,x) in zc: out[y][x]=fc
    return out
'''
